kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.gf_detail: Ask. Small plates that change monthly — sashimi, tamagoyaki, teppan egg, stuffed peppers with meat miso, a teppan hamburg, fried oysters, conger tempura; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-meat standing bar — sashimi, chicken, hamburg, oysters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.hours_raw: Monday 15:00–23:00; Tuesday–Saturday 15:00–23:30; Sunday 13:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash or PayPay; no cards (Tabelog). A standing bar for about 40, with a large L-shaped counter and round tables (Tabelog; September 2026). Smoking outside the entrance (Tabelog). Down an alley across the Takase River from Kiyamachi, about 150 m from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station (Tabelog; 2026).
kyoto_kokoro_standing_bar.notes: [Standing bar · Kawaramachi back alley, monthly small plates] A roomy, neon-lit standing bar down an alley off Kiyamachi, open from mid-afternoon: ¥480 draft beer and a monthly-changing list of more than fifty small plates — sashimi, peppers with meat miso, chicken-liver sashimi, a teppan egg you mix yourself. Cash or PayPay; no bookings.

chef_bio.background: Regulars praise food a level above a typical standing bar and a menu that changes every month (October and November 2026). A November 2026 reviewer calls it a sister shop of “Momiji”; reviewers describe a cheerful owner (October 2026) and four or five lively staff (August and September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A first-time solo visitor in August 2026 felt at ease among the regulars thanks to the cheerful staff, and resolved to return on every Kyoto trip.
An October 2026 visitor, whose usual standing bar was closed, ducked in out of the rain and stayed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ココロ、立ち飲み居酒屋・バー、下京区四条通小橋西入真町455-5 セザンヌビル1F、京都河原町駅から151m、月 15:00〜23:00、火〜土 15:00〜23:30、日 13:00〜22:00、予約不可、現金・PayPayのみ、40席、店外に灰皿。口コミ (2026年、英語): 立ち飲みとは思えない料理、毎月替わるメニュー、50品以上、生ビール480円、瓶ビール中580円、日本酒は1,000円以上が多い、肉味噌のせピーマン420円、鶏レバー刺し680円、日替わりソースの鉄板ハンバーグ580円、刺身、卵焼き、チーズと明太子の鉄板たまご、自家製タルタルのカキフライ、鱧の天ぷら、明るい店主、もみじの姉妹店 (2026年11月の口コミ)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar; cash or PayPay; no bookings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-vegetable izakaya dishes — meat-stuffed Kamo eggplant, nama-fu (wheat gluten) pizza, yuba, simmered dishes, meat sushi; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto vegetables and yuba feature, but the signature dishes use meat, bacon and cheese, and nothing is described as vegan (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.hours_raw: Sunday–Thursday and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); Friday, Saturday and the eve of holidays 17:00–2:00 (L.O. 1:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; at busy times seating may be limited to 2 hours, and from 27 December to 3 January to 90 minutes without free-flow drinks (Tabelog). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB) (Tabelog). 128 seats with private rooms (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2026). On the 5th floor of a building above a club on Nishikiyamachi, a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi exit 1A (Tabelog; 2024 and February 2026). Opened 20 July 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_hitokuchi_kawaramachi.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi 5F, Kyoto vegetables for groups] A large upstairs izakaya a minute from Hankyu Kawaramachi, with private rooms and all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans from ¥2,400: Kyoto vegetables, a whole Kamo eggplant stuffed with minced meat, nama-fu pizza and yuba. Open late — until 2:00 on Fridays and Saturdays. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text pitches cheap all-you-can-eat-and-drink plans with private rooms for parties. Reviewers mention young, energetic staff (November 2025) and a slight smell of tobacco (February 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner on the Kyoto cuisine course added meat sushi at ¥99 and called it a bargain.
A February 2025 guest chose it for the fully private rooms where smoking was allowed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 旬野菜×京居酒屋 ひとくち、居酒屋・日本料理・郷土料理、下京区西木屋町通四条上ル真町97 イマージアムビル5F、日〜木・祝 17:00〜24:00、金土・祝前日 17:00〜翌2:00、予約可 (混雑時は2時間制)、カード可、128席、個室あり、喫煙可、2021年7月20日オープン、140品以上の食べ飲み放題2,400円から。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 京野菜、賀茂なすの肉詰め、生麩のピザ、湯葉、京料理の飲み放題コース、肉寿司99円、抹茶ビール、若く元気な店員、たばこの匂い。

cultural_comfort.note: Group izakaya with private rooms; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.
